title: Hyperlocal Neighborhood Directory & Spot Mapper
name: Hyperlocal Neighborhood Directory & Spot Mapper
user_prompt: Create a hyperlocal neighborhood discovery, business comparison, and community spot-mapping web app pre-seeded in central London. Allow users to enter an address or select a neighborhood via Places Autocomplete and Geocoding, filter nearby places across categories (restaurants, cafes, museums, parks) within a 5km radius using Places API (New) nearby/text search, and view custom category markers on the map. Provide a side-by-side comparison and details drawer showing live ratings, price levels, opening hours, and reviews. Also support clicking anywhere on the map to reverse-geocode the human-readable street address and coordinates so users can inspect or pin a new community spot.
